user.description: Sign in with the account you use in the Perific app.

data_description.username: The email address the Perific account is registered to.

reauth_confirm.description: The Perific API is no longer accepting the token for {username}. Enter the password again to sign back in.

error.cannot_connect: Failed to connect to the Perific API.
error.rate_limited: The Perific API is rate limiting requests. Wait a few minutes and try again.

abort.already_configured: This Perific account is already set up.
abort.already_in_progress: Setup for this Perific account is already underway. Finish or close the open dialog first.

init.description: How often to poll the Perific API. The energy registers only advance once a minute; the real-time bucket updates every 10 seconds, so a shorter interval buys fresher power and current readings and nothing else. The API's rate limits are undocumented, so lower this gradually.

rate_limited.title: Perific is rate limiting requests
rate_limited.description:
The Perific API is refusing requests because they are arriving too quickly, so the sensors will stay unavailable until it lets us back in.

The poll interval is currently {seconds} seconds. Raise it under Settings > Devices & services > Perific > Configure. This message disappears on its own once a poll succeeds.
